text:
sophia: Heads-up: created a minimal Next starter that wires LlamaIndex + LangChain for docs search. Running into onboarding friction: starter's postinstall check is failing for folks using pnpm workspaces and throwing errors. Repo: https://git.company/oss/next-monorepo-starter
ken: can you paste the failure?
sophia: postinstall script expects package-lock.json or yarn.lock and exits non-zero when neither exists. New users with pnpm get blocked during install.
pkg-bot: install run: node scripts/check-runtime-parity.js -> Error: lockfile not found -> exit 1
anna: Oof. We intended that check to prevent SDK serializer mismatches (node vs edge) which cause "unrecognized snapshot" and silent rebuilds. But breaking installs is too aggressive.
chris: UX fix: change postinstall to warn (console.warn) when lockfile missing, and provide a CI-only validator job that enforces parity for our repos. Also add an opt-in env var to opt-out for monorepos.
ken: Also add a tiny dev-time validator in the starter that checks serializer roundtrip: persist a tiny index -> load it back -> if mismatch, show a clear actionable error linking to the README. That gives immediate guidance without failing installs.
sophia: good call. I'll update script to be non-fatal, add README troubleshooting, and include a jest e2e that does SSR persist -> edge load -> assert no rebuild (we'll check trace spans).
anna: while you're at it, pin @redwood/inference in package.json examples (exact version) and show an example of explicit serializer usage: idx.persist({ serializer: 'json.v1' }) and loadIndex('kb', { serializer: 'json.v1' }). That mitigates subtle runtime parity when users upgrade independently.
chris: SDK change request: emit a helpful logger when loading snapshots that prints the serializer codec and SDK semver to make diagnostics easier in prod. File an SDK issue and include link in starter README.
ken: one more: the starter README should clarify Vercel edge vs Node server boundaries and recommend server-only index builds + client-side embed calls for most users to avoid token rotation+runtime mismatch footguns.
sophia: will open a PR with: (1) postinstall -> warn-only, (2) ci-validate-runtime GH action, (3) exact package pins in examples, (4) serializer examples, (5) jest e2e harness, (6) README troubleshooting. tagging @anna for review.
anna: thanks. low-sev install pain but high onboarding impact. once merged, let's backport the validator to other starters. :rocket:
